name: @kjanat/tsc-bridge
description: Experimental JS access to the native TypeScript compiler.

scripts.fetch: mkdir -p bin && for ref in "${WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA:-master}" "${WORKERS_CI_BRANCH:-master}" master; do curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 --retry 2 --output bin/tsc-bridge.tgz "https://pkg.pr.new/kjanat/micro509/@kjanat/tsc-bridge@$ref" && tar -xzf bin/tsc-bridge.tgz --strip-components=1 package/bin/tsc-bridge && rm bin/tsc-bridge.tgz && exit; done; rm -f bin/tsc-bridge.tgz; exit 1
